description: Define and implement the HydratedGitHubContext type that normalizes all three comment source types (issue comment, PR conversation comment, PR line comment) into a single structure the classifier and agent can consume. Fields: sourceType, issue/PR metadata, all relevant comments, file context (for line comments), truncation flags. This is the output contract for T-015 and T-016.
title: Context normalization (unified HydratedGitHubContext type)
